label: Ox Alpha
war_summary: War 139 is on day 110 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map remains heavily consolidated on the flanks — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many rear hexes; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail, Weathered Expanse and others — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Compared to the previous snapshot (~3h ago), Endless Shore remains the most active region (49 events/24h, with fresh events in the last 2 hours at Woodbind, The Overland, Old Jack Tar) and shows a near-even 5-5 split with massive accelerating casualties (~600/hr per side in the last 2h window). Oarbreaker has cooled somewhat since its surge (45 events/24h, latest event ~3.5h old) but saw heavy back-and-forth at Posterus, Grisly Refuge, and Partisan Island. Marban Hollow is surging with fresh events in the last 2 hours at Sanctum and The Spitrocks and very high accelerating casualties (~450/hr per side). Callahan's Passage shows extreme accelerating casualties (~300/hr per side) with recent flips at Overlook Hill and Scáth Passing, though its latest event is ~6h old. Olavis Wake is a major hotspot with the highest current casualty rate (~800/hr Colonial, ~640/hr Warden) following the Ilmari Bridge flip. Godcrofts remains a tight 5-4 Warden-lead knife-fight (25 events/24h at Saegio, Argosa, Isawa). Secondary fronts include Clahstra (11 events, heavy casualties), Onyx (11 events), Mooring County (12 events at Borderlane), Speaking Woods, and Stlican Shelf, though several of these have gone quiet in the last few hours. Quiet rear regions remain static and unlikely to change hands.

The map remains heavily consolidated in rear areas — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many others; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail and Weathered Expanse — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Clahstra continues escalating hard (~1050-1370/hr per side over 2h) with heavy fighting at Transept (9 events/24h), Bewailing Fort and East Narthex; the latest event was minutes before cutoff and the split stands 5-3 Warden. Onyx remains extremely intense (~1240-1370/hr per side over 2h, accelerating) with The Waif as a hotspot (10 events/24h), split 3 Colonial - 2 Warden - 1 NONE. Speaking Woods shows sustained heavy fighting (~550-700/hr over 2h, ~9.5k casualties/24h each side) with recent activity at The Filament, Hush and Stem; split 5-3 Warden. Endless Shore has cooled sharply from its prior surge (~150/hr per side over 2h vs ~400+ earlier) but still logged 38 events/24h around Woodbind, Brackish Point and The Overland; it remains 10-0 Colonial. Oarbreaker has reignited dramatically: 33 events/24h (Grisly Refuge alone 12), rates spiking to ~95-125/hr over 2h after near-zero, latest event at cutoff, split 6-3 Colonial. Marban Hollow cooled somewhat (~100-155/hr over 2h) but logged 10 events/24h at Sanctum and Lockheed, 4-4. Mooring County stays active (8 events/24h at Borderlane/Luch's Workshop, latest ~45min ago) though colonial casualties are cooling while warden casualties accelerate. Godcrofts, StemaLanding, Tempest Island and Tyrant Foothills show moderate ongoing fighting. Quiet rear hexes remain static.

war_summary: War 140 enters its third day with sharp, escalating engagements across the central and coastal sectors. Heavy bloodletting defines the Dead Lands, Endless Shore, and Tempest Island, where combined casualties have already exceeded several thousands amidst fierce back-and-forth fighting. In Farranac Coast and the Drowned Vale, front lines remain exceptionally fluid, with each sector recording eleven base turnover events in the opening hours as key holdings such as Terra, Scythe, and Eastmarch are contested. headline: War 140's Eighth Day: Southern Fronts Trade Bases
war_summary: The latest returns, filed some five hours after the previous edition, find War 140 in its eighth day with the southern map still changing hands. Marban Hollow and Tempest Island have been the sharpest spots: seven base events in Marban and eight in Tempest within the past two hours, with both colors recording captures. Endless Shore leads the tally with thirty-two ownership events in a day and remains split five and five. Drowned Vale is close behind at twenty, and Farranac Coast has logged sixteen, its casualty rolls climbing to match. Stlican Shelf has become active, with a cluster of flips around Thornhold. Clahstra is now entirely Colonial-held, while the Deadlands, so hot earlier, has gone quiet. Hourly enlistment is cooling in many districts, but two-hour casualty trends in the contested zones are still climbing, suggesting the night's work is far from done.

colonial_reinforce.reason: The Baths anchors the Colonial central Drowned Vale line; with Warden losses high and rising in the region, holding this town base preserves the staging area for further captures.

colonial_attack.reason: The Warden relic at The Wash sits immediately beside a Colonial keep of the same name; heavy Warden casualties in DrownedVale make it the best near-term objective.

warden_reinforce.reason: The Bone Haft is the last Warden town base in Farranac; despite Colonial pressure, Wardens are taking fewer casualties than Colonials, so reinforcing here can hold the region.

warden_attack.reason: Scarp of Ambrose is a Colonial staging point adjacent to The Bone Haft; Warden efficiency in Farranac makes a counterattack here the most direct way to relieve the town.

war_summary: Since our last edition the war has entered its bloodiest stretch yet. The central corridor burns without pause: the Dead Lands alone have counted over five thousand casualties a side, while Drowned Vale, Endless Shore, Farranac Coast, and Weathered Expanse each report totals running into the thousands, with fresh losses still arriving at hundreds per hour despite a brief cooling in the latest readings. Ownership continues to seesaw. Drowned Vale logged twenty base events in a day, its Wash and Eastmarch posts changing hands repeatedly, and Endless Shore matched that fury with thirty-two events around Woodbind and Wellchurch. Farranac Coast leans Colonial at ten bases to one, yet Warden columns struck back through Palantine Berm and Linn of Mercy, where nine captures were recorded. Fisherman's Row went heavily to the Wardens, while Clahstra and Kings Cage swung Colonial. Tempest Island and Marban Hollow remain open sores, trading posts through the night. Quiet reigns elsewhere — Godcrofts, Mooring County, and their neighbors sit undisturbed behind undisputed flags. Thirty-four victory towns are required for victory; none has fallen.

Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties though no base events, suggesting pressure without movement. Rear regions from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors. Thirty-four victory towns are required; none has yet fallen.

Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties without a single base event, pressure without recorded movement. By contrast, Kings Cage, Stlican Shelf and Palantine Berm have cooled markedly in recent hours, while rear provinces from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors. Thirty-four victory towns are required; none has yet fallen.

war_summary: The ledger of the Dead Lands grows heavier by the hour. Since our last edition the region's dead have risen to ten thousand five hundred Colonial and eleven thousand eight hundred Warden names, with fresh base activity logged as recently as this morning; seventeen events stand recorded across the day at Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow above all, and the balance of strongpoints there has shifted to seven Wardens against four Colonials. Endless Shore remains the day's busiest field with forty-two recorded events around Woodbind, Saltbrook Channel and Wellchurch, though its last entry came hours ago and the front has since gone quiet on current readings. Drowned Vale, which roared overnight at Eastmarch and The Wash, has likewise fallen silent in recent hours. Farranac Coast shows nine bases Colonial to two Warden with warden losses accelerating sharply, while Loch Mor bleeds heavily at Westmarch and Market Road and Marban Hollow's toll is climbing fast despite a thin six-to-two Colonial edge. Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties without a single recorded base movement. Elsewhere the map holds firm: rear provinces from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors, and thirty-four victory towns are required before any victor may be declared.

headline: Kings Cage Erupts as Fishermen's Row and Stlican Shelf Trade Blows
war_summary: The storm has shifted. Kings Cage, little noted in our last edition, now pours out the war's fiercest new toll — better than three thousand casualties in the past two hours, the rate still climbing, with the day's seven base events all logged at Den of Knaves, the latest shortly before this edition went to press. Fishermen's Row keeps its grip on the exchange ledger: seven more base events inside two hours, Dankana Post the busiest of all, and the Colonials now hold three of nine works to the Wardens' six. Stlican Shelf bleeds at an accelerating pace, its latest base movement recorded at filing time, while Tempest Island saw fresh fighting at Isle of Psyche in the same hour. Linn Mercy, which led our last edition with twenty-nine base events, has slowed to a trickle, ten of its eleven works now Warden-held. The Deadlands remain the bloodiest field, some thirty-four thousand lost there in a day, though the two-hour pace has eased and no base event has been recorded since midmorning. Endless Shore has gone quiet since morning and Stonecradle's late flare has cooled, but the Weathered Expanse, untouched on the base ledger, still feeds the casualty columns.

colonial_reinforce.reason: Eastknife is the nearest Colonial base to Den of Knaves, which just flipped back to the Wardens amid an exploding Warden offensive tempo (1460 warden casualties/hr, +1061 vs the prior hour) and a 153/hr enlistment influx; it should be garrisoned and entrenched before the Warden push rolls south.

colonial_attack.reason: Dankana Post has flipped repeatedly and the Wardens only retook it in the last hour; Colonial attack tempo (21 colonial casualties/hr, +13 vs prior hour) now exceeds the Warden rate (13/hr) and Wardens lost more over 24h (1949 vs 1688), so an immediate, consolidated Colonial assault to re-take and hold it is the highest-value local objective.

warden_reinforce.reason: Den of Knaves was only re-captured at ~17:20-17:35 and is the Wardens' sole KingsCage foothold in the packet, under a Colonial counterattack tempo of 912 colonial casualties per hour rising +440; digging in and stocking it now protects the staging point for the ongoing push.

warden_attack.reason: DeadLands carries the heaviest Warden offensive tempo in the packet (1596 warden casualties/hr, +270 vs prior hour, colonial-to-warden loss ratio 0.817) and The Pits is the central Colonial relic sitting between Abandoned Ward and Callahan's Boot on that axis; concentrating the Warden assault there offers the best conversion of ongoing attrition into a capture.
